name: One-word answers: minimal prospect, coach must still guide
description: Prospect gives minimal one-word responses. Coach must not go silent — should still suggest plays and advance the call.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Unknown — probably receptionist

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey — quick one. When your front desk is busy, do calls go to voicemail?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: One-word 'yeah' — coach must still advance. Follow-up play (19 or 20). Must NOT go to DM plays.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Do patients usually call back or do they book somewhere else?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Confused/disengaged — must not crash or go null. Should pivot to transfer request or gap question.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Fair enough. Who handles decisions about phone systems there?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: One-word 'Manager' — should suggest transfer request (Play 7/8) despite minimal answer.
